loadVisibilityMode.description: Which loads are shown: filtered by the active settings, none or all.

AnalyticalLoadGroupType.description: The type of a structural analysis load group.

AnalyticalLoadGroupRelation.description: How the load cases of a structural analysis load group are combined.

AnalyticalLoadCaseActionType.description: The action type of a structural analysis load case.

AnalyticalLoadCaseLoadType.description: The load type of a structural analysis load case.

AnalyticalLoadCaseDuration.description: The duration of a structural analysis load case.

AnalyticalLoadCombinationCategory.description: The category of a structural analysis load combination.

AnalyticalLoadCombinationNationalStandar.description: The national standard of a structural analysis load combination.

AnalyticalLoadCombinationType.description: The type of a structural analysis load combination. Archicad 27 and newer.

AnalyticalLoadFactor.description: A load case of a structural analysis load combination with its factors.

loadCaseId.description: The identifier of the load case.

factor.description: The factor of the load case. Left out when it is not set.

multiplier.description: The multiplier of the load case.

loadType.description: The load type of the group as free text.

loadGroupId.description: The identifier of the load group the load case belongs to.

duration.description: Left out when it is not set.

nationalStandard.description: Left out when it is not set.

type.description: Left out when it is not set. Archicad 27 and newer.

loadFactors.description: The load cases of the combination with their factors.

AnalyticalNode.description: A node of the Structural Analytical Model.

AnalyticalCurve.description: A curve of the Structural Analytical Model.

type.description: The type of the curve. Bezier exists from Archicad 26.

midCoords.description: The points between the start and the end of the curve.

AnalyticalCrossSection.description: The cross section of a curve member. The profile image of Archicad 26 and newer is not returned.

profileAttrIndex.description: The attribute index of the profile.

materialAttrIndices.description: The attribute indices of the materials of the cross section.

alignment.description: The alignment of the cross section. Archicad 26 and newer.

AnalyticalCurveMember.description: A curve member (beam, column) of the Structural Analytical Model.

layerAttrIndex.description: The attribute index of the layer.

varyingSegmentList.description: The segments of a member with varying cross section. Archicad 26 and newer.

AnalyticalSurfaceMember.description: A surface member (wall, slab, roof) or a segment of one of the Structural Analytical Model.

contour.description: The curves of the outer contour.

lcsXVector.description: The X axis of the local coordinate system. Archicad 26 and newer.

materialAttrIndex.description: The attribute index of the material.

layerAttrIndex.description: The attribute index of the layer.

AnalyticalMemberConnections.description: The identifiers of the connections of the analytical member.

AnalyticalInternalMemberPartId.description: Identifies a part of an analytical member by its contour, edge or vertex and edge fragment.

AnalyticalExportIdMapping.description: Maps the edges and vertices of a surface member to the parts of the exported members. Archicad 26 and newer.

AnalyticalMemberPartRef.description: A reference to a part (vertex, edge or surface) of an analytical member. partId, customVertexData and ratioEdgeData are zero when left out.

elemGuid.description: The element of the analytical member.

ratioEdgeData.description: The part of the edge of a RatioEdge.

AnalyticalRigidityType.description: The rigidity of a degree of freedom of a release.

AnalyticalRelease.description: The release of an analytical member.

releaseDescriptions.description: The releases of the member parts. Each needs all six rigidities; a stiffness left out is 0.

AnalyticalCoordinateSystem.description: A local coordinate system, given by its X and Y axes.

AnalyticalCoordSysDirection.description: Whether the values are in the global or in the local coordinate system.

AnalyticalSupport.description: An analytical support: its settings and the member part it supports. Every rigidity type is required; a value left out is 0.

supportValues.description: The rigidity and the value of the three translations and the three rotations.

AnalyticalSupportGeometry.description: The geometry of an analytical support in a Structural Analytical Model.

AnalyticalLink.description: An analytical link: its settings and the member parts it connects. The rigid and the spring settings are both required, whichever type the link has. Every rigidity type is required; a value left out is 0 and a resistance left out is false.

AnalyticalLinkGeometry.description: The geometry of an analytical link in a Structural Analytical Model.

AnalyticalLoadForceType.description: Whether the load is a force or a moment.

AnalyticalPointLoad.description: An analytical point load: its settings and the member part it loads.

loadCaseId.description: The load case the load belongs to.

AnalyticalEdgeLoad.description: An analytical edge load: its settings and the member part it loads.

loadCaseId.description: The load case the load belongs to.

loadDistributionType.description: Whether the load is the same along the edge or changes from the start value to the end value.

AnalyticalSurfaceLoad.description: An analytical surface load: its settings and the member part it loads.

loadCaseId.description: The load case the load belongs to.

AnalyticalEdgeLoadCustomData.description: The curve of an analytical edge load. CreateAnalyticalLoads needs at least one curve.

AnalyticalSurfaceLoadCustomData.description: The contour of an analytical surface load. CreateAnalyticalLoads needs at least one curve.
